tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The live site's --bg. Everything sits on this; the explainer scenes fade into it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, chapter cards, the depth drawer. One step up from ground; separate it with line, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A control or row inside a surface (a hovered chapter, a selected depth tab).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and display text on ground and surface. The live site's --fg. 15:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, the masthead marks, taglines. 5.9:1 on ground dark, 6.3:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Only for text 24px and up, rules, tick marks and disabled controls: about 3:1 on ground, which fails for small text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card borders, table rules, the baseline grid in scenes. Borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: learner
tokens.usage: The learner, always. Ember. Text, strokes, the learner's node in every scene. 9:1 on ground dark, 4.8:1 light. Never used for anything that is not the learner.

tokens.name: learner-soft
tokens.usage: Halo behind the learner node, the learner's highlighted row. 16% alpha of learner; never a text colour.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: The guide, always. Tide. Lighter than learner in dark, darker in light, so the two read apart without hue. 7:1 on ground dark, 8:1 light.

tokens.name: guide-soft
tokens.usage: Halo behind a guide node, the guide's highlighted row. 16% alpha of guide; never a text colour.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: The learning record: the thread that grows through every scene, the record card, the ledger line. Paper. 12:1 on ground dark, 9:1 light.

tokens.name: record-soft
tokens.usage: The record's trail behind the thread; the fill of a record block. 12% alpha of record; never a text colour.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Errors and one-off warnings only. Small. 7:1 on ground dark, 7:1 light.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings: a 1px outline in ink with 3px offset, as the live site does.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links inherit ink and carry a 1px line underline; hover lifts the underline to ink. No link colour.

tokens.name: scene-fog
tokens.usage: Three.js scene.fog and renderer clear colour: identical to ground so a scene has no edge.

tokens.name: scene-wire
tokens.usage: Wireframe and grid helpers inside a scene; the orbit rings around the learner.

tokens.name: run-metadax
tokens.usage: Meta DAX, everywhere it appears: its graph node, its door, the accent of its run's pages. Green. Never used for anything that is not Meta DAX.

tokens.name: run-novadax
tokens.usage: Nova DAX: its graph node, its door, the accent of its run's pages. Red.

tokens.name: run-skippydax
tokens.usage: Skippy DAX: its graph node, its door, the accent of its run's pages. Blue.

tokens.name: run-cp
tokens.usage: The Constraint Protocol: the lines between everything. Gold. Its node, its door, the accent of its run's pages.

tokens.name: run-foundation
tokens.usage: The Foundation map itself (the record colour).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between a label and its value, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; the dot pitch in scene grids.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding from tablet up; the page's side gutter (1.5rem).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a scene's caption and its next block; masthead padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a chapter; the orbit ring pitch in the thirty-roles scene.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between chapters on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between chapters from tablet up; the pin distance of a scroll scene.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Rules, tables, the record card: the site is square by default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chapter cards, the depth drawer, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Scene frames on phones; the Ask panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Nodes, pills, the learner and guide discs.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: The site's reading column (44rem). Prose never wider.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: The wide column (52rem) for tables and the record card.

tokens.name: measure-scene
tokens.usage: A scene's frame on desktop; full-bleed on phones.

tokens.name: scene-height
tokens.usage: Pinned scene height on desktop; phones use the viewport height minus the masthead.

tokens.name: node-learner
tokens.usage: The learner disc. Always the largest node in a scene.

tokens.name: node-guide
tokens.usage: A guide disc.

tokens.name: node-role
tokens.usage: One of the thirty roles.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Every tappable thing on a phone.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Icon and diagram stroke width.

tokens.name: glow-learner
tokens.usage: The only shadow: a halo under the learner node when it is the subject of the scene. Nothing else casts a shadow.
